2607.08196.title: A First-Principles Theory of Slow Thinking and Active Perception
2607.08196.paper_summary: As part of a series on first-principles modeling of cognitive functions, this paper attempts to provide a mathematical formulation of thinking and perception. It formally derives slow thinking or more generally, active perception, and encompasses the design, training and inference of slow thinking large language models. Our starting point is the lifting and projection of probability distributions on the observable and latent spaces, with the objective of representing complex data distributions by simple function families such as neural networks. A theory called "active lifting" is proposed, based on the sampling of latent sequences and an intrinsic drive to reduce uncertainty with maximum rate. It derives a large design space, containing the slow thinking models in a subspace that we call the static theory. These models are positioned on the representation hierarchy and sampler hierarchy induced by the static theory, and can be upgraded by climbing the two hierarchies. Active lifting further derives an inference process with an internal time axis, and a training objective that resembles minimum-length coding as well as the invention of languages. Thus, it characterizes the agency of perception, including the emergence of the slow thinking formats. Technical by-products of this theory include a three-stage pathway for improving slow thinking models, a unified approach to constructing encoders and generative models for all data modalities, a priori formation of human-like visual representations, and a possible solution to policy collapse.
2607.08196.paper_summary_zh: 作為關於認知功能第一原則建模系列的一部分，本文試圖提供思考和感知的數學公式。它正式推導了慢思考或更一般地說，主動感知，並涵蓋了慢思考大型語言模型的設計、訓練和推理。我們的起點是可觀察和潛在空間上概率分佈的提升和投影，目的是通過簡單的函數族如神經網絡來表示複雜的數據分佈。提出了一種稱為「主動提升」的理論，基於潛在序列的採樣和內在驅動以最大速率減少不確定性。它推導出一個大型設計空間，其中包含我們稱之為靜態理論的子空間中的慢思考模型。這些模型位於靜態理論所誘導的表示層次和採樣器層次上，並可以通過攀登這兩個層次進行升級。主動提升進一步推導出一個具有內部時間軸的推理過程，以及一個類似於最小長度編碼和語言發明的訓練目標。因此，它特徵化了感知的主體性，包括慢思考格式的出現。該理論的技術副產品包括改善慢思考模型的三階段途徑、為所有數據模態構建編碼器和生成模型的統一方法、人類類似視覺表徵的先驗形成，以及對政策崩潰的可能解決方案。
